dry.definition: expert-visible scaling/flaking on the photographed surface, not water content or barrier function
dry.localization: expert polygons of visible flaking, plus invalid/occluded pixel polygons

sag.definition: expert-visible lower-cheek/jowl contour laxity under standardized neutral pose, not mechanical elasticity
sag.localization: expert-defined contour intervals and regional grades; local fill requires a separately validated local annotation target

capture.expression: neutral, lips relaxed, no smile or forced eye squint
capture.lighting: recorded diffuse light direction, fixed exposure/white balance; separate repeat capture and lighting challenge sets
capture.source: native uncropped unmirrored RGB with resolution and camera condition metadata; analysis excludes overlay screenshots
capture.limitations: macro/side-light visible scaling capture may be required; unavailable detail is not reconstructed

expertReview.split: case-based 60/20/20 with duplicate photo components kept together; separate camera-domain holdout

rights.policy: data/code/derived-weight permissions are separate; never infer model distribution rights from code license
